name: Octopus Countertop Blender
shortDescription: A powerful blender that crushes ice and blends smooth with seven presets
description: The Octopus Countertop Blender has the power for daily smoothies and tougher jobs alike. A 1500W motor and seven presets handle most of the work, and a one-touch clean cycle rinses the jug so you don't have to.

image.alt: Octopus Countertop Blender with its glass jug

lifestyleImages.alt: The countertop blender full of watermelon and mango on a sunny kitchen bench
A woman pressing the touch panel of the blender, a smoothie in the jug

features.title: Powers through the tough stuff
features.description: A 1500W motor lets you do anything from crushing ice to blending smoothies

image.alt: Ice, strawberries and banana being crushed by the blades

features.title: Skip the scrubbing
features.description: Add water and a little detergent, press clean, and the blender cleans itself

image.alt: Water swirling in the jug during the self-clean cycle

features.title: Control in short bursts
features.description: The pulse function runs the blades in bursts, giving you even more control

image.alt: The blades spinning in a creamy mixture, seen from above

features.title: A preset for the everyday
features.description: Seven intelligent presets for smoothies, soups, purées & more

image.alt: A finger pressing the presets on the blender touch panel
